description: We are the Robotics Team of Liceo Campestre Nuevo Pacto, a group of students passionate about technology, innovation, and robotics. We are characterized by our curiosity, creativity, and constant desire to learn, explore, and discover new ways to turn our ideas into reality. Our passion for technology and robotics inspires us to design, build, and program projects that challenge our skills and knowledge. Through teamwork, experimentation, and problem-solving, we strive to overcome new challenges
